checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, horizon, condition display, e1 citation and not_due/unresolved outcome all match. One limitation fails. It says the obligations 'extend beyond an unspecified payment horizon', which is a factual claim that nothing in the evidence supports. The contract only flags that the obligations and their payment horizon are not precisely identified. It should say the obligations and their payment horizon are unspecified.

The e1 excerpt 'unnerved debt investors' is cherry-picked. The source sentence starts with 'Initially' and the next one says 'But that eased'. The worry was about Nvidia's leverage, not trouble funding data centers. As shown, it misstates the source's support for the condition. A fairer quote would be 'No deals were signed by the time of the announcement'. The excerpt, proposition, e2 citation and open_horizon/unresolved outcome otherwise match.
